prompt_text:
ANCIENT NARRATIVE FRESCO — SEMANTIC ROLE LOCK.
SCENE ARCHETYPE: ARCHITECTURAL_EVENT.
CENTRAL VISUAL SUBJECT: an ancient engineered threshold complex of gates, chambers and passages, with no subsystem depicted as a person.
CENTRAL ACTION: the architectural mechanism changes state in the exact order described by the source, with one transition clearly dominating the scene.
VISIBLE PEOPLE: none required; do not invent a person.
SUPPORTING ACTIONS: small side-register scenes show earlier and later architectural states; failed or unresolved paths stay visibly closed.
MAIN SYMBOLS: mechanical gates; sealed passages; state-changing chambers; one visually dominant transition.
STYLE: painted directly on cracked aged lime plaster; ancient narrative fresco using mineral pigments; weathered hand-painted wall surface, not sculpture and not 3d render; layered historical storytelling with small side-register scenes.
RULES: the scene archetype determines whether people are present; system names and internal identifiers never become humans or deities by name alone; named gates adapters protocols repositories and state-machine states remain mechanisms or provenance; the central visual action must come from the semantic role of the source, not from token name collisions; architecture may dominate only for ARCHITECTURAL_EVENT; all epistemic limits remain visually non-triumphal.

Translate the source meaning into a coherent visual scene. Do not personify internal names, repository names, protocol names, gates, adapters, controllers, state-machine labels or software components. A human or deity may appear only when an explicit person/mythic entity is established by a person-role field or descriptive narrative. Keep unconfirmed or prohibited claims visually unresolved or closed, never triumphant. No readable code, no UI, no literal JSON.
negative_prompt: false personification, single classical statue, marble statue, bodybuilder statue, male statue when no male person is described, female deity when no female person is described, empty hall, plain interior, abstract pattern, striped textile, decorative fabric, ornamental bands, flat tapestry pattern, non-figurative abstraction, geometric wallpaper, pattern-only composition, woven rug, modern UI, screenshot, JSON text, caption, watermark, logo, glossy 3d render, plastic skin, extra limbs, extra legs, extra fingers, duplicated people, deformed anatomy, malformed hands, illegible typography, central human hero, central goddess, central god, mythic woman, mythic man, heroic statue, portrait composition

source_trace.value: ADV_Elite = autonomous room brain + portable personal terminal + smart-home organ.
M2R = physics-informed forward World Model / future-state generator; adaptive temporal resolution subordinate.
1488 activates full M2R active future-simulation mode.
Predict WORLD + SWARM + SELF within observability/model boundaries; no literal retrocausality.
JANUS is distributed swarm cognition; ADV_Elite is one autonomous predictive organ.
Every device is solo-capable; swarm connectivity optional; collective learning provenance-preserving.
Tiered memory + swarm offload + safe forgetting; anomalies/rare/forensic episodes pinned.
Canonical JANUS JSON; runtime JSONL/NDJSON; sealed JSON chunks/manifests; per-node/session hash chain.
ADV authors/classifies JSON; trusted gateway publishes; no GitHub token on ESP32.
Legacy HRAIN/Titan uplink becomes nonblocking Outbox; ADV -> Gateway -> GitHub JSON -> HRain read-only graph.
Removed legacy loveExperimentActive gate from anomaly visibility.
Anomaly layer always on; ensemble Z + robust-Z/MAD + prediction error + disagreement + derivatives/context; onboard LED; L toggles LED only; [/] shared brightness.
1488 remains exclusive manual full-M2R gate; anomalies raise attention/sampling/Witness only.
All admitted swarm participants are trusted peers; packet checks are transport sanity/freshness, not distrust.
ENTER toggles absolute global audio mute; no audio exceptions.
BrainWave maps real state to musical controls; HELIOS renders retro-cosmic procedural sonification; music is never evidence.
112269 = amber full-suite safe boost; House does not enable M2R or LoRa; J remains manual LoRa control.
Methodology linked for future self-study/falsification; no runtime authority or silent control override.
LOVE = HOUSE_112269 && LORA_J; Love is a derived cognitive/experimental state. Turning off House or J clears active Love without deleting history.
Historical CuP is corrected to CAP: physical top-mounted CAP-LoRa-1262 GNSS+LoRa expansion hardware, not a JANUS mode/protocol. J remains manual LoRa control.
Exact GNSS may be shared inside trusted JANUS swarm; raw coordinates redacted from public/GitHub/external LoRa/HRain by default.
Delete ADV Elite gameplay completely from target; retain technical donor organs only.
Restore one unified historical Beacon HUD with no tabs; preserve old character/colors/retro-cosmic style/familiar keys and moving status ticker.
Tabbed UI proposal rejected as inconvenient.
Ramanujan Theta is an internal M2R operator, not a separate mode. M2R keeps theta-on and theta-off traces to measure real incremental predictive value.
Legacy synthetic SHA-home is retired; SHA rarity is not a cognitive-quality judge.

Full automation: safe learnable parameter/policy candidates autonomously PROMOTE after frozen replay + unseen future holdout + shadow + hard-constraint PASS; known-good snapshot and automatic rollback are mandatory; no human approval after PASS.
